reasons: The cited Term clause (p0078) provides automatic renewal for successive one-year periods with a mutual non-renewal right exercisable on written notice 'no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year' — 12-month renewal terms and a 30-day window, which satisfies the preferred position's material terms and is far inside the 90-day walk-away threshold.

The failed deterministic check ('number not found') is a phrasing artifact: the window is spelled out as 'thirty (30) days' rather than in a form the regex matched; substance confirms a ≤60-day (indeed ≤30-day) window.
Consistent with the claimed compliant status, no redline and no counterparty comment were produced — the rendered text is identical to the original.

The rationale correctly treats the absent 60-day Vendor reminder and the absent CPI/3% uplift cap as minor sub-elements noted rather than flagged, per the playbook's classification semantics, and correctly identifies the Section 6 first-year price freeze / most-favoured-rate language as not amounting to a renewal uplift cap.
